categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Changes in src/util/fs.h are minor helper additions (+5 lines) strictly supporting the wallet migration logic.
categories.rationale: Incidental utility helper changes in service of wallet migration do not make this a utilities category PR.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and directly modifies legacy-to-SQLite wallet migration logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents wallet corruption and manual backup recovery during migration failures by staging the SQLite database before deleting the original BerkeleyDB files. The PR description notes that previously, migration failures left wallets in an inconsistent state requiring manual recovery because the original database was deleted before ensuring the new SQLite database was fully created.
